Jhn.3.34.bsb: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
Jhn.3.34.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

Jhn.3.35.bsb: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
Jhn.3.35.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

Jhn.3.36.bsb: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
Jhn.3.36.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

Jhn.5.20.bsb: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
Jhn.5.20.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

Jhn.5.21.bsb: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
Jhn.5.21.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

Jhn.5.22.bsb: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
Jhn.5.22.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

Jhn.5.23.bsb: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
Jhn.5.23.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

Jhn.5.24.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
Jhn.5.24.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

Jhn.5.25.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
Jhn.5.25.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

Jhn.5.26.bsb: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
Jhn.5.26.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

Jhn.5.27.bsb: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
Jhn.5.27.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

Jhn.5.28.bsb: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
Jhn.5.28.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

Jhn.5.29.bsb: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
Jhn.5.29.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

Jhn.5.30.bsb: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
Jhn.5.30.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

Jhn.14.28.bsb: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
Jhn.14.28.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

Jhn.17.2.bsb: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
Jhn.17.2.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

Jhn.17.3.bsb: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
Jhn.17.3.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

Jhn.17.4.bsb: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
Jhn.17.4.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

Jhn.17.5.bsb: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
Jhn.17.5.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

Jhn.7.24.bsb: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”
Jhn.7.24.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

Jhn.5.4.kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

Jhn.1.51.bsb: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
Jhn.1.51.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

Jhn.20.21.bsb: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”
Jhn.20.21.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

Jhn.3.2.bsb: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
Jhn.3.2.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

Jhn.3.13.bsb: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
Jhn.3.13.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

Jhn.17.6.bsb: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
Jhn.17.6.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

Jhn.17.14.bsb: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
Jhn.17.14.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

Jhn.17.26.bsb: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
Jhn.17.26.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

Jhn.8.26.bsb: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
Jhn.8.26.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

Jhn.8.28.bsb: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.
Jhn.8.28.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

Jhn.12.49.bsb: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
Jhn.12.49.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

Jhn.12.50.bsb: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”
Jhn.12.50.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

Jhn.14.10.bsb: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.
Jhn.14.10.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

Jhn.14.24.bsb: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
Jhn.14.24.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.

Jhn.15.15.bsb: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
Jhn.15.15.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

Jhn.17.8.bsb: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
Jhn.17.8.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

Jhn.17.16.bsb: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
Jhn.17.16.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

Jhn.7.46.bsb: “Never has anyone spoken like this man!” the officers answered.
Jhn.7.46.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

Jhn.1.3.bsb: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
Jhn.1.3.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

Jhn.1.10.bsb: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
Jhn.1.10.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

Jhn.17.21.bsb: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
Jhn.17.21.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

Jhn.17.22.bsb: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
Jhn.17.22.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

Jhn.17.23.bsb: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
Jhn.17.23.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

Jhn.10.16.bsb: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
Jhn.10.16.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

Jhn.1.1.bsb: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Jhn.1.1.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

Jhn.1.2.bsb: He was with God in the beginning.
Jhn.1.2.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.

Jhn.1.4.bsb: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
Jhn.1.4.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

Jhn.1.5.bsb: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
Jhn.1.5.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

Jhn.10.30.bsb: I and the Father are one.”
Jhn.10.30.kjv: I and my Father are one.

Jhn.10.38.bsb: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”
Jhn.10.38.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

Jhn.12.41.bsb: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him.
Jhn.12.41.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

Jhn.10.11.bsb: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
Jhn.10.11.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

Jhn.10.14.bsb: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
Jhn.10.14.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

Jhn.1.9.bsb: The true Light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
Jhn.1.9.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

Jhn.14.6.bsb: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
Jhn.14.6.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

Jhn.11.25.bsb: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
Jhn.11.25.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

Jhn.1.14.bsb: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
Jhn.1.14.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

Jhn.2.11.bsb: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
Jhn.2.11.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

Jhn.12.21.bsb: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
Jhn.12.21.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

Jhn.12.23.bsb: But Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
Jhn.12.23.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

Jhn.17.24.bsb: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
Jhn.17.24.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

Jhn.3.6.bsb: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
Jhn.3.6.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

Jhn.3.19.bsb: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
Jhn.3.19.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

Jhn.3.16.bsb: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
Jhn.3.16.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

Jhn.12.3.bsb: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
Jhn.12.3.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

Jhn.4.7.bsb: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
Jhn.4.7.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

Jhn.19.28.bsb: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
Jhn.19.28.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

Jhn.4.6.bsb: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
Jhn.4.6.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

Jhn.11.33.bsb: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
Jhn.11.33.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

Jhn.12.27.bsb: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.
Jhn.12.27.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

Jhn.19.30.bsb: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.
Jhn.19.30.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

Jhn.19.34.bsb: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
Jhn.19.34.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

Jhn.18.38.bsb: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.
Jhn.18.38.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

Jhn.8.46.bsb: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
Jhn.8.46.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

Jhn.20.27.bsb: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
Jhn.20.27.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

Jhn.4.2.bsb: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
Jhn.4.2.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

Jhn.7.27.bsb: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”
Jhn.7.27.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

Jhn.19.5.bsb: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
Jhn.19.5.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

Jhn.13.34.bsb: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
Jhn.13.34.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

Jhn.15.12.bsb: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
Jhn.15.12.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

Jhn.13.35.bsb: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
Jhn.13.35.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

Jhn.2.25.bsb: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
Jhn.2.25.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

Jhn.19.36.bsb: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
Jhn.19.36.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

Jhn.14.13.bsb: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
Jhn.14.13.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

Jhn.14.14.bsb: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
Jhn.14.14.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

Jhn.15.16.bsb: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
Jhn.15.16.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

Jhn.16.23.bsb: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
Jhn.16.23.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

Jhn.16.24.bsb: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
Jhn.16.24.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

Jhn.4.22.bsb: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
Jhn.4.22.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

Jhn.4.23.bsb: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
Jhn.4.23.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

Jhn.4.24.bsb: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
Jhn.4.24.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

Jhn.4.10.bsb: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
Jhn.4.10.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

Jhn.4.14.bsb: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
Jhn.4.14.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

Jhn.11.42.bsb: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”
Jhn.11.42.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

Jhn.15.7.bsb: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
Jhn.15.7.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

Jhn.9.31.bsb: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
Jhn.9.31.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

Jhn.17.9.bsb: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
Jhn.17.9.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

Jhn.17.10.bsb: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
Jhn.17.10.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

Jhn.17.11.bsb: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
Jhn.17.11.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

Jhn.17.12.bsb: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
Jhn.17.12.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

Jhn.17.13.bsb: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
Jhn.17.13.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

Jhn.17.15.bsb: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
Jhn.17.15.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

Jhn.17.17.bsb: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
Jhn.17.17.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

Jhn.17.18.bsb: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
Jhn.17.18.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

Jhn.17.19.bsb: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
Jhn.17.19.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

Jhn.17.20.bsb: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
Jhn.17.20.kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

Jhn.2.13.bsb: When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
Jhn.2.13.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

Jhn.2.14.bsb: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
Jhn.2.14.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

Jhn.2.15.bsb: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle. He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
Jhn.2.15.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;

Jhn.2.16.bsb: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”
Jhn.2.16.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.

Jhn.2.17.bsb: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
Jhn.2.17.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

Jhn.11.47.bsb: Then the chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.
Jhn.11.47.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

Jhn.1.11.bsb: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
Jhn.1.11.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

Jhn.7.3.bsb: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.
Jhn.7.3.kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

Jhn.15.24.bsb: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
Jhn.15.24.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

Jhn.15.25.bsb: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
Jhn.15.25.kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

Jhn.7.48.bsb: “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?
Jhn.7.48.kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

Jhn.13.18.bsb: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
Jhn.13.18.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

Jhn.13.21.bsb: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
Jhn.13.21.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

Jhn.19.1.bsb: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
Jhn.19.1.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

Jhn.19.18.bsb: There they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.
Jhn.19.18.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

Jhn.20.25.bsb: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
Jhn.20.25.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

Jhn.19.33.bsb: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
Jhn.19.33.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

Jhn.19.37.bsb: And, as another Scripture says: “They will look on the One they have pierced.”
Jhn.19.37.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

Jhn.18.33.bsb: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
Jhn.18.33.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

Jhn.18.34.bsb: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”
Jhn.18.34.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

Jhn.18.35.bsb: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”
Jhn.18.35.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

Jhn.18.36.bsb: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
Jhn.18.36.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

Jhn.18.37.bsb: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
Jhn.18.37.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

Jhn.11.49.bsb: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
Jhn.11.49.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

Jhn.11.50.bsb: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”
Jhn.11.50.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

Jhn.11.51.bsb: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,
Jhn.11.51.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

Jhn.1.45.bsb: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
Jhn.1.45.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

Jhn.2.6.bsb: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification. Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.
Jhn.2.6.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

Jhn.3.25.bsb: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing.
Jhn.3.25.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.

Jhn.1.12.bsb: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
Jhn.1.12.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

Jhn.1.13.bsb: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.
Jhn.1.13.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

Jhn.11.52.bsb: and not only for the nation, but also for the scattered children of God, to gather them together into one.
Jhn.11.52.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

Jhn.20.12.bsb: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
Jhn.20.12.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

Jhn.6.67.bsb: So Jesus asked the Twelve, “Do you want to leave too?”
Jhn.6.67.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

Jhn.15.6.bsb: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
Jhn.15.6.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

Jhn.6.66.bsb: From that time on many of His disciples turned back and no longer walked with Him.
Jhn.6.66.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

Jhn.20.28.bsb: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
Jhn.20.28.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

Jhn.20.29.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
Jhn.20.29.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

Jhn.19.7.bsb: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
Jhn.19.7.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

Jhn.9.1.bsb: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
Jhn.9.1.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

Jhn.9.2.bsb: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
Jhn.9.2.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

Jhn.9.3.bsb: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
Jhn.9.3.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

Jhn.9.4.bsb: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
Jhn.9.4.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

Jhn.9.5.bsb: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
Jhn.9.5.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

Jhn.9.6.bsb: When Jesus had said this, He spit on the ground, made some mud, and applied it to the man’s eyes.
Jhn.9.6.kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

Jhn.9.7.bsb: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.
Jhn.9.7.kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

Jhn.3.4.bsb: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
Jhn.3.4.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

Jhn.3.7.bsb: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’
Jhn.3.7.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

Jhn.3.9.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

Jhn.3.10.bsb: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
Jhn.3.10.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

Jhn.3.11.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
Jhn.3.11.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

Jhn.3.12.bsb: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
Jhn.3.12.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

Jhn.3.20.bsb: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
Jhn.3.20.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

Jhn.3.31.bsb: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
Jhn.3.31.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

Jhn.4.11.bsb: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
Jhn.4.11.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

Jhn.4.15.bsb: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
Jhn.4.15.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

Jhn.6.52.bsb: At this, the Jews began to argue among themselves, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”
Jhn.6.52.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

Jhn.6.60.bsb: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
Jhn.6.60.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

Jhn.7.28.bsb: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,
Jhn.7.28.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

Jhn.8.12.bsb: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Jhn.8.12.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

Jhn.8.15.bsb: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
Jhn.8.15.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

Jhn.8.19.bsb: “Where is Your Father?” they asked Him. “You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”
Jhn.8.19.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

Jhn.8.27.bsb: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
Jhn.8.27.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

Jhn.8.33.bsb: “We are Abraham’s descendants,” they answered. “We have never been slaves to anyone. How can You say we will be set free?”
Jhn.8.33.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

Jhn.8.42.bsb: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
Jhn.8.42.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

Jhn.8.43.bsb: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you are unable to accept My message.
Jhn.8.43.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

Jhn.8.52.bsb: “Now we know that You have a demon!” declared the Jews. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste death.
Jhn.8.52.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

Jhn.8.54.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
Jhn.8.54.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

Jhn.8.55.bsb: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
Jhn.8.55.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

Jhn.8.57.bsb: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
Jhn.8.57.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

Jhn.9.29.bsb: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
Jhn.9.29.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

Jhn.9.30.bsb: “That is remarkable indeed!” the man said. “You do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes.
Jhn.9.30.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

Jhn.9.32.bsb: Never before has anyone heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
Jhn.9.32.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

Jhn.9.33.bsb: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
Jhn.9.33.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

Jhn.9.34.bsb: They replied, “You were born in utter sin, and you are instructing us?” And they threw him out.
Jhn.9.34.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

Jhn.9.35.bsb: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”
Jhn.9.35.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

Jhn.9.36.bsb: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
Jhn.9.36.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

Jhn.9.37.bsb: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”
Jhn.9.37.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

Jhn.9.38.bsb: “Lord, I believe,” he said. And he worshiped Jesus.
Jhn.9.38.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

Jhn.9.39.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”
Jhn.9.39.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

Jhn.12.38.bsb: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
Jhn.12.38.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

Jhn.12.39.bsb: For this reason they were unable to believe. For again, Isaiah says:
Jhn.12.39.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

Jhn.12.40.bsb: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”
Jhn.12.40.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

Jhn.14.17.bsb: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
Jhn.14.17.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

Jhn.15.21.bsb: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
Jhn.15.21.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

Jhn.16.2.bsb: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
Jhn.16.2.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

Jhn.16.3.bsb: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
Jhn.16.3.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

Jhn.17.25.bsb: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
Jhn.17.25.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

Jhn.19.26.bsb: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”
Jhn.19.26.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

Jhn.19.27.bsb: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.
Jhn.19.27.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

Jhn.4.46.bsb: So once again He came to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
Jhn.4.46.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

Jhn.4.47.bsb: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son, who was about to die.
Jhn.4.47.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

Jhn.4.48.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
Jhn.4.48.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

Jhn.4.49.bsb: “Sir,” the official said, “come down before my child dies.”
Jhn.4.49.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

Jhn.4.50.bsb: “Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.” The man took Jesus at His word and departed.
Jhn.4.50.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

Jhn.4.51.bsb: And while he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was alive.
Jhn.4.51.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

Jhn.4.52.bsb: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour.”
Jhn.4.52.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

Jhn.4.53.bsb: Then the father realized that this was the very hour in which Jesus had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and all his household believed.
Jhn.4.53.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

Jhn.4.54.bsb: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee.
Jhn.4.54.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judea into Galilee.

Jhn.21.15.bsb: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
Jhn.21.15.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

Jhn.14.2.bsb: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
Jhn.14.2.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

Jhn.10.8.bsb: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
Jhn.10.8.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

Jhn.10.12.bsb: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.
Jhn.10.12.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

Jhn.13.13.bsb: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
Jhn.13.13.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

Jhn.15.1.bsb: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
Jhn.15.1.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

Jhn.15.2.bsb: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.
Jhn.15.2.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

Jhn.15.3.bsb: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
Jhn.15.3.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

Jhn.15.4.bsb: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
Jhn.15.4.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

Jhn.15.5.bsb: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
Jhn.15.5.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

Jhn.15.8.bsb: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.
Jhn.15.8.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

Jhn.20.23.bsb: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”
Jhn.20.23.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

Jhn.9.22.bsb: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
Jhn.9.22.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

Jhn.8.35.bsb: A slave does not remain in the house forever, but a son remains forever.
Jhn.8.35.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

Jhn.11.11.bsb: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”
Jhn.11.11.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

Jhn.19.16.bsb: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.
Jhn.19.16.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

Jhn.19.17.bsb: Carrying His own cross, He went out to The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
Jhn.19.17.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

Jhn.19.19.bsb: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
Jhn.19.19.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

Jhn.19.20.bsb: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
Jhn.19.20.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

Jhn.19.21.bsb: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
Jhn.19.21.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

Jhn.19.22.bsb: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
Jhn.19.22.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

Jhn.19.23.bsb: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
Jhn.19.23.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

Jhn.19.24.bsb: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture: “They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.” So that is what the soldiers did.
Jhn.19.24.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

Jhn.19.25.bsb: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.
Jhn.19.25.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

Jhn.19.29.bsb: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
Jhn.19.29.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

Jhn.6.50.bsb: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
Jhn.6.50.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

Jhn.6.51.bsb: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
Jhn.6.51.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

Jhn.6.53.bsb: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
Jhn.6.53.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

Jhn.11.26.bsb: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
Jhn.11.26.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

Jhn.10.22.bsb: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
Jhn.10.22.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

Jhn.8.23.bsb: Then He told them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
Jhn.8.23.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

Jhn.4.34.bsb: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
Jhn.4.34.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

Jhn.6.38.bsb: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
Jhn.6.38.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

Jhn.14.15.bsb: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
Jhn.14.15.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

Jhn.14.21.bsb: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
Jhn.14.21.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

Jhn.15.14.bsb: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
Jhn.15.14.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

Jhn.11.27.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
Jhn.11.27.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

Jhn.3.33.bsb: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
Jhn.3.33.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

Jhn.3.14.bsb: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
Jhn.3.14.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

Jhn.3.15.bsb: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
Jhn.3.15.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

Jhn.3.18.bsb: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
Jhn.3.18.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

Jhn.6.20.bsb: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
Jhn.6.20.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

Jhn.6.29.bsb: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
Jhn.6.29.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

Jhn.6.35.bsb: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
Jhn.6.35.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

Jhn.6.45.bsb: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
Jhn.6.45.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

Jhn.6.47.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.
Jhn.6.47.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

Jhn.7.38.bsb: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
Jhn.7.38.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

Jhn.11.40.bsb: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
Jhn.11.40.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

Jhn.12.36.bsb: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.
Jhn.12.36.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

Jhn.12.44.bsb: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.
Jhn.12.44.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

Jhn.12.46.bsb: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
Jhn.12.46.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

Jhn.13.7.bsb: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
Jhn.13.7.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

Jhn.13.20.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”
Jhn.13.20.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

Jhn.14.1.bsb: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
Jhn.14.1.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

Jhn.14.11.bsb: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
Jhn.14.11.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

Jhn.14.12.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
Jhn.14.12.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

Jhn.16.27.bsb: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
Jhn.16.27.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

Jhn.16.33.bsb: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
Jhn.16.33.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

Jhn.20.31.bsb: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
Jhn.20.31.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

Jhn.4.29.bsb: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
Jhn.4.29.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

Jhn.4.42.bsb: They said to the woman, “We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world.”
Jhn.4.42.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

Jhn.6.14.bsb: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
Jhn.6.14.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

Jhn.6.68.bsb: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
Jhn.6.68.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

Jhn.6.69.bsb: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God.”
Jhn.6.69.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

Jhn.7.31.bsb: Many in the crowd, however, believed in Him and said, “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?”
Jhn.7.31.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

Jhn.10.41.bsb: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
Jhn.10.41.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

Jhn.10.42.bsb: And many in that place believed in Jesus.
Jhn.10.42.kjv: And many believed on him there.

Jhn.11.21.bsb: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
Jhn.11.21.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

Jhn.11.22.bsb: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
Jhn.11.22.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

Jhn.11.32.bsb: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
Jhn.11.32.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

Jhn.16.30.bsb: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
Jhn.16.30.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

Jhn.1.41.bsb: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
Jhn.1.41.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

Jhn.1.46.bsb: “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.
Jhn.1.46.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

Jhn.1.49.bsb: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
Jhn.1.49.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

Jhn.4.39.bsb: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
Jhn.4.39.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

Jhn.4.40.bsb: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed two days.
Jhn.4.40.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

Jhn.4.41.bsb: And many more believed because of His message.
Jhn.4.41.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;

Jhn.8.56.bsb: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
Jhn.8.56.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

Jhn.9.13.bsb: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
Jhn.9.13.kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

Jhn.9.14.bsb: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
Jhn.9.14.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

Jhn.9.15.bsb: So the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. The man answered, “He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and now I can see.”
Jhn.9.15.kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

Jhn.9.16.bsb: Because of this, some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others said, “How can a sinful man perform such signs?” And there was division among them.
Jhn.9.16.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

Jhn.9.17.bsb: So once again they asked the man who had been blind, “What do you say about Him, since it was your eyes He opened?” “He is a prophet,” the man replied.
Jhn.9.17.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

Jhn.9.18.bsb: The Jews still did not believe that the man had been blind and had received his sight until they summoned his parents
Jhn.9.18.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

Jhn.9.19.bsb: and asked, “Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?”
Jhn.9.19.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

Jhn.9.20.bsb: His parents answered, “We know he is our son, and we know he was born blind.
Jhn.9.20.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

Jhn.9.21.bsb: But how he can now see or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.”
Jhn.9.21.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

Jhn.9.23.bsb: That was why his parents said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
Jhn.9.23.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

Jhn.9.24.bsb: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
Jhn.9.24.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

Jhn.9.25.bsb: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
Jhn.9.25.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

Jhn.9.26.bsb: “What did He do to you?” they asked. “How did He open your eyes?”
Jhn.9.26.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

Jhn.9.27.bsb: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
Jhn.9.27.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

Jhn.9.28.bsb: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
Jhn.9.28.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.

Jhn.20.8.bsb: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
Jhn.20.8.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

Jhn.2.23.bsb: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.
Jhn.2.23.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

Jhn.8.30.bsb: As Jesus spoke these things, many believed in Him.
Jhn.8.30.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

Jhn.11.45.bsb: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in Him.
Jhn.11.45.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

Jhn.12.11.bsb: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus.
Jhn.12.11.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

Jhn.6.5.bsb: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
Jhn.6.5.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

Jhn.6.6.bsb: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
Jhn.6.6.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

Jhn.21.16.bsb: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
Jhn.21.16.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

Jhn.21.17.bsb: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
Jhn.21.17.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

Jhn.11.1.bsb: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
Jhn.11.1.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

Jhn.11.2.bsb: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
Jhn.11.2.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

Jhn.11.3.bsb: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
Jhn.11.3.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

Jhn.11.4.bsb: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
Jhn.11.4.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

Jhn.11.5.bsb: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
Jhn.11.5.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

Jhn.10.7.bsb: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
Jhn.10.7.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

Jhn.10.9.bsb: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
Jhn.10.9.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

Jhn.1.18.bsb: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father’s side, has made Him known.
Jhn.1.18.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
