Jhn.4.21.bsb: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
Jhn.4.21.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

Jhn.5.17.bsb: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
Jhn.5.17.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

Jhn.5.18.bsb: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
Jhn.5.18.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

Jhn.5.19.bsb: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
Jhn.5.19.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

Jhn.5.36.bsb: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
Jhn.5.36.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

Jhn.5.37.bsb: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
Jhn.5.37.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

Jhn.5.43.bsb: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
Jhn.5.43.kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

Jhn.6.27.bsb: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
Jhn.6.27.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

Jhn.6.32.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
Jhn.6.32.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

Jhn.6.44.bsb: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
Jhn.6.44.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

Jhn.6.46.bsb: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
Jhn.6.46.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

Jhn.8.38.bsb: I speak of what I have seen in the presence of the Father, and you do what you have heard from your father.”
Jhn.8.38.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

Jhn.8.41.bsb: You are doing the works of your father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”
Jhn.8.41.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

Jhn.8.49.bsb: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
Jhn.8.49.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

Jhn.10.15.bsb: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.
Jhn.10.15.kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

Jhn.10.29.bsb: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
Jhn.10.29.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

Jhn.10.32.bsb: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
Jhn.10.32.kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

Jhn.10.33.bsb: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, make Yourself out to be God.”
Jhn.10.33.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

Jhn.10.36.bsb: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
Jhn.10.36.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

Jhn.10.37.bsb: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.
Jhn.10.37.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

Jhn.12.26.bsb: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
Jhn.12.26.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

Jhn.12.28.bsb: Father, glorify Your name!” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
Jhn.12.28.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

Jhn.13.3.bsb: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
Jhn.13.3.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

Jhn.14.7.bsb: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
Jhn.14.7.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

Jhn.14.8.bsb: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
Jhn.14.8.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

Jhn.14.9.bsb: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
Jhn.14.9.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

Jhn.14.16.bsb: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
Jhn.14.16.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

Jhn.14.20.bsb: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.
Jhn.14.20.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

Jhn.14.23.bsb: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
Jhn.14.23.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

Jhn.14.26.bsb: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
Jhn.14.26.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

Jhn.14.31.bsb: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
Jhn.14.31.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

Jhn.15.9.bsb: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
Jhn.15.9.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

Jhn.15.10.bsb: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
Jhn.15.10.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

Jhn.15.23.bsb: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
Jhn.15.23.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

Jhn.15.26.bsb: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.
Jhn.15.26.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

Jhn.16.10.bsb: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;
Jhn.16.10.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

Jhn.16.15.bsb: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
Jhn.16.15.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

Jhn.16.25.bsb: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
Jhn.16.25.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

Jhn.16.26.bsb: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
Jhn.16.26.kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

Jhn.16.28.bsb: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”
Jhn.16.28.kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

Jhn.17.1.bsb: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
Jhn.17.1.kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

Jhn.20.17.bsb: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
Jhn.20.17.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

Jhn.8.50.bsb: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
Jhn.8.50.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

Jhn.13.31.bsb: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
Jhn.13.31.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

Jhn.13.32.bsb: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
Jhn.13.32.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

Jhn.14.18.bsb: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
Jhn.14.18.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

Jhn.14.19.bsb: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
Jhn.14.19.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

Jhn.10.3.bsb: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
Jhn.10.3.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

Jhn.10.4.bsb: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
Jhn.10.4.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

Jhn.16.13.bsb: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.
Jhn.16.13.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

Jhn.6.31.bsb: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
Jhn.6.31.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

Jhn.3.17.bsb: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
Jhn.3.17.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

Jhn.6.39.bsb: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
Jhn.6.39.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

Jhn.19.11.bsb: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
Jhn.19.11.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

Jhn.19.12.bsb: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
Jhn.19.12.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.

Jhn.19.13.bsb: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.
Jhn.19.13.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

Jhn.19.14.bsb: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
Jhn.19.14.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

Jhn.19.15.bsb: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.
Jhn.19.15.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.

Jhn.19.10.bsb: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?”
Jhn.19.10.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

Jhn.1.32.bsb: Then John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
Jhn.1.32.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

Jhn.1.33.bsb: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
Jhn.1.33.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

Jhn.3.5.bsb: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
Jhn.3.5.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

Jhn.6.63.bsb: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
Jhn.6.63.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

Jhn.7.39.bsb: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive. For the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
Jhn.7.39.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

Jhn.16.7.bsb: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
Jhn.16.7.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

Jhn.16.8.bsb: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:
Jhn.16.8.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

Jhn.16.9.bsb: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;
Jhn.16.9.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

Jhn.16.11.bsb: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
Jhn.16.11.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

Jhn.16.12.bsb: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
Jhn.16.12.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

Jhn.16.14.bsb: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.
Jhn.16.14.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

Jhn.20.22.bsb: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
Jhn.20.22.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

Jhn.5.39.bsb: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
Jhn.5.39.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

Jhn.5.40.bsb: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
Jhn.5.40.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

Jhn.6.40.bsb: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
Jhn.6.40.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

Jhn.6.54.bsb: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
Jhn.6.54.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

Jhn.6.58.bsb: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
Jhn.6.58.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

Jhn.10.28.bsb: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
Jhn.10.28.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

Jhn.7.14.bsb: About halfway through the feast, Jesus went up to the temple courts and began to teach.
Jhn.7.14.kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

Jhn.8.2.bsb: Early in the morning He went back into the temple courts. All the people came to Him, and He sat down to teach them.
Jhn.8.2.kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

Jhn.7.35.bsb: At this, the Jews said to one another, “Where does He intend to go that we will not find Him? Will He go where the Jews are dispersed among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
Jhn.7.35.kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

Jhn.12.48.bsb: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
Jhn.12.48.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

Jhn.5.45.bsb: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
Jhn.5.45.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

Jhn.9.41.bsb: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
Jhn.9.41.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

Jhn.15.22.bsb: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
Jhn.15.22.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

Jhn.8.44.bsb: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
Jhn.8.44.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

Jhn.18.22.bsb: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
Jhn.18.22.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

Jhn.18.23.bsb: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
Jhn.18.23.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

Jhn.3.3.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”
Jhn.3.3.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

Jhn.3.8.bsb: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
Jhn.3.8.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

Jhn.2.1.bsb: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
Jhn.2.1.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

Jhn.2.2.bsb: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
Jhn.2.2.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

Jhn.2.3.bsb: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
Jhn.2.3.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

Jhn.2.4.bsb: “Woman, what is that to you and to Me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
Jhn.2.4.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

Jhn.2.5.bsb: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”
Jhn.2.5.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

Jhn.12.6.bsb: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.
Jhn.12.6.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

Jhn.17.7.bsb: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
Jhn.17.7.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

Jhn.6.11.bsb: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
Jhn.6.11.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

Jhn.6.23.bsb: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
Jhn.6.23.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

Jhn.6.37.bsb: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
Jhn.6.37.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

Jhn.15.19.bsb: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
Jhn.15.19.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

Jhn.21.23.bsb: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
Jhn.21.23.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

Jhn.1.19.bsb: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
Jhn.1.19.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

Jhn.18.15.bsb: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
Jhn.18.15.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

Jhn.18.16.bsb: But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
Jhn.18.16.kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

Jhn.18.17.bsb: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.
Jhn.18.17.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.

Jhn.18.18.bsb: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.
Jhn.18.18.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

Jhn.18.19.bsb: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
Jhn.18.19.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

Jhn.18.20.bsb: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
Jhn.18.20.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

Jhn.18.21.bsb: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”
Jhn.18.21.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

Jhn.18.24.bsb: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
Jhn.18.24.kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

Jhn.18.25.bsb: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
Jhn.18.25.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

Jhn.18.26.bsb: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
Jhn.18.26.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

Jhn.18.27.bsb: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.
Jhn.18.27.kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

Jhn.18.28.bsb: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
Jhn.18.28.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

Jhn.18.29.bsb: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
Jhn.18.29.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

Jhn.18.30.bsb: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
Jhn.18.30.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

Jhn.18.31.bsb: “You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews replied.
Jhn.18.31.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

Jhn.18.32.bsb: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
Jhn.18.32.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

Jhn.12.13.bsb: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”
Jhn.12.13.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

Jhn.7.42.bsb: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived?”
Jhn.7.42.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

Jhn.12.14.bsb: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:
Jhn.12.14.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

Jhn.12.15.bsb: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”
Jhn.12.15.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.

Jhn.18.1.bsb: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
Jhn.18.1.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

Jhn.18.2.bsb: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
Jhn.18.2.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

Jhn.18.3.bsb: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
Jhn.18.3.kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

Jhn.18.4.bsb: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
Jhn.18.4.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

Jhn.18.5.bsb: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
Jhn.18.5.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

Jhn.18.6.bsb: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
Jhn.18.6.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

Jhn.18.7.bsb: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
Jhn.18.7.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

Jhn.18.8.bsb: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
Jhn.18.8.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

Jhn.18.9.bsb: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
Jhn.18.9.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

Jhn.4.44.bsb: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
Jhn.4.44.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

Jhn.1.6.bsb: There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John.
Jhn.1.6.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

Jhn.11.55.bsb: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.
Jhn.11.55.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

Jhn.3.21.bsb: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”
Jhn.3.21.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

Jhn.8.31.bsb: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
Jhn.8.31.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

Jhn.8.32.bsb: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
Jhn.8.32.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

Jhn.8.39.bsb: “Abraham is our father,” they replied. “If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.
Jhn.8.39.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

Jhn.8.47.bsb: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
Jhn.8.47.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

Jhn.10.5.bsb: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”
Jhn.10.5.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

Jhn.10.27.bsb: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
Jhn.10.27.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

Jhn.8.51.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”
Jhn.8.51.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

Jhn.12.25.bsb: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
Jhn.12.25.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

Jhn.13.36.bsb: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
Jhn.13.36.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

Jhn.14.3.bsb: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
Jhn.14.3.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

Jhn.6.55.bsb: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.
Jhn.6.55.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

Jhn.6.56.bsb: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
Jhn.6.56.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

Jhn.6.57.bsb: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
Jhn.6.57.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

Jhn.15.11.bsb: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
Jhn.15.11.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

Jhn.8.34.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
Jhn.8.34.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

Jhn.13.16.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
Jhn.13.16.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

Jhn.8.11.bsb: “No one, Lord,” she answered. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Now go and sin no more.”
Jhn.8.11.kjv: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

Jhn.4.17.bsb: “I have no husband,” the woman replied. Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
Jhn.4.17.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

Jhn.4.18.bsb: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
Jhn.4.18.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

Jhn.4.19.bsb: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
Jhn.4.19.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

Jhn.5.42.bsb: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
Jhn.5.42.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

Jhn.6.64.bsb: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
Jhn.6.64.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

Jhn.13.11.bsb: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
Jhn.13.11.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

Jhn.12.43.bsb: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
Jhn.12.43.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

Jhn.10.19.bsb: Again there was division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message.
Jhn.10.19.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

Jhn.12.42.bsb: Nevertheless, many of the leaders believed in Him. But because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue.
Jhn.12.42.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

Jhn.2.20.bsb: “This temple took forty-six years to build,” the Jews replied, “and You are going to raise it up in three days?”
Jhn.2.20.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

Jhn.10.23.bsb: and Jesus was walking in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade.
Jhn.10.23.kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.

Jhn.5.14.bsb: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”
Jhn.5.14.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

Jhn.5.15.bsb: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
Jhn.5.15.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

Jhn.5.16.bsb: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
Jhn.5.16.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

Jhn.7.15.bsb: The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
Jhn.7.15.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

Jhn.7.16.bsb: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
Jhn.7.16.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

Jhn.7.17.bsb: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
Jhn.7.17.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

Jhn.7.18.bsb: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.
Jhn.7.18.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

Jhn.7.19.bsb: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”
Jhn.7.19.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

Jhn.7.20.bsb: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
Jhn.7.20.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

Jhn.7.21.bsb: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
Jhn.7.21.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

Jhn.7.22.bsb: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
Jhn.7.22.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

Jhn.7.23.bsb: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?
Jhn.7.23.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

Jhn.7.25.bsb: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
Jhn.7.25.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

Jhn.7.26.bsb: Yet here He is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying anything to Him. Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?
Jhn.7.26.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

Jhn.10.24.bsb: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
Jhn.10.24.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

Jhn.10.25.bsb: “I already told you,” Jesus replied, “but you did not believe. The works I do in My Father’s name testify on My behalf.
Jhn.10.25.kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

Jhn.10.26.bsb: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe.
Jhn.10.26.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

Jhn.10.31.bsb: At this, the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him.
Jhn.10.31.kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

Jhn.10.34.bsb: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?
Jhn.10.34.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

Jhn.10.35.bsb: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—
Jhn.10.35.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

Jhn.2.19.bsb: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”
Jhn.2.19.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

Jhn.11.41.bsb: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
Jhn.11.41.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

Jhn.1.17.bsb: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
Jhn.1.17.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

Jhn.5.33.bsb: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
Jhn.5.33.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

Jhn.20.14.bsb: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there. But she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
Jhn.20.14.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

Jhn.20.15.bsb: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
Jhn.20.15.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

Jhn.20.16.bsb: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
Jhn.20.16.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

Jhn.20.18.bsb: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.
Jhn.20.18.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

Jhn.20.1.bsb: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
Jhn.20.1.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

Jhn.20.2.bsb: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”
Jhn.20.2.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

Jhn.20.11.bsb: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
Jhn.20.11.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

Jhn.20.13.bsb: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked. “Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”
Jhn.20.13.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

Jhn.8.1.bsb: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
Jhn.8.1.kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

Jhn.8.3.bsb: The scribes and Pharisees, however, brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before them
Jhn.8.3.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

Jhn.8.4.bsb: and said, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
Jhn.8.4.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

Jhn.8.5.bsb: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman. So what do You say?”
Jhn.8.5.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

Jhn.8.6.bsb: They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him. But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.
Jhn.8.6.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

Jhn.8.7.bsb: When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
Jhn.8.7.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

Jhn.8.8.bsb: And again He bent down and wrote on the ground.
Jhn.8.8.kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

Jhn.8.9.bsb: When they heard this, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.
Jhn.8.9.kjv: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

Jhn.8.10.bsb: Then Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”
Jhn.8.10.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

Jhn.7.52.bsb: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
Jhn.7.52.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

Jhn.2.22.bsb: After He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. Then they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
Jhn.2.22.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

Jhn.5.46.bsb: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
Jhn.5.46.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

Jhn.5.47.bsb: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
Jhn.5.47.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

Jhn.8.37.bsb: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.
Jhn.8.37.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

Jhn.8.45.bsb: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!
Jhn.8.45.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

Jhn.18.39.bsb: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
Jhn.18.39.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

Jhn.6.21.bsb: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
Jhn.6.21.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

Jhn.21.22.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
Jhn.21.22.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

Jhn.2.9.bsb: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
Jhn.2.9.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

Jhn.8.16.bsb: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
Jhn.8.16.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

Jhn.1.30.bsb: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
Jhn.1.30.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

Jhn.5.44.bsb: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
Jhn.5.44.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

Jhn.16.19.bsb: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?
Jhn.16.19.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

Jhn.1.20.bsb: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
Jhn.1.20.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

Jhn.10.17.bsb: The reason the Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up again.
Jhn.10.17.kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

Jhn.6.26.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
Jhn.6.26.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

Jhn.1.7.bsb: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
Jhn.1.7.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

Jhn.3.26.bsb: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
Jhn.3.26.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

Jhn.4.16.bsb: Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
Jhn.4.16.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

Jhn.7.12.bsb: Many in the crowds were whispering about Him. Some said, “He is a good man.” But others replied, “No, He deceives the people.”
Jhn.7.12.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

Jhn.19.3.bsb: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.
Jhn.19.3.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

Jhn.12.9.bsb: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came not only because of Him, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
Jhn.12.9.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

Jhn.8.58.bsb: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
Jhn.8.58.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

Jhn.5.10.bsb: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
Jhn.5.10.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

Jhn.7.30.bsb: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
Jhn.7.30.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

Jhn.3.1.bsb: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
Jhn.3.1.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

Jhn.5.2.bsb: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
Jhn.5.2.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

Jhn.18.10.bsb: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
Jhn.18.10.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

Jhn.3.24.bsb: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison.)
Jhn.3.24.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.

Jhn.4.26.bsb: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.”
Jhn.4.26.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

Jhn.8.40.bsb: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
Jhn.8.40.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

Jhn.6.19.bsb: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.
Jhn.6.19.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

Jhn.3.28.bsb: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
Jhn.3.28.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

Jhn.2.24.bsb: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
Jhn.2.24.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

Jhn.6.8.bsb: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
Jhn.6.8.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,

Jhn.1.16.bsb: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
Jhn.1.16.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

Jhn.7.47.bsb: “Have you also been deceived?” replied the Pharisees.
Jhn.7.47.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

Jhn.13.17.bsb: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
Jhn.13.17.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

Jhn.11.57.bsb: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
Jhn.11.57.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

Jhn.12.32.bsb: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
Jhn.12.32.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

Jhn.15.18.bsb: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
Jhn.15.18.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

Jhn.11.12.bsb: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
Jhn.11.12.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

Jhn.7.4.bsb: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”
Jhn.7.4.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

Jhn.1.21.bsb: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
Jhn.1.21.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

Jhn.21.5.bsb: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.
Jhn.21.5.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

Jhn.8.29.bsb: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.”
Jhn.8.29.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

Jhn.12.19.bsb: Then the Pharisees said to one another, “You can see that this is doing you no good. Look how the whole world has gone after Him!”
Jhn.12.19.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

Jhn.4.35.bsb: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
Jhn.4.35.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

Jhn.11.6.bsb: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,
Jhn.11.6.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

Jhn.13.14.bsb: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
Jhn.13.14.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

Jhn.5.41.bsb: I do not accept glory from men,
Jhn.5.41.kjv: I receive not honour from men.

Jhn.10.39.bsb: At this, they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped their grasp.
Jhn.10.39.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

Jhn.13.4.bsb: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
Jhn.13.4.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

Jhn.12.1.bsb: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
Jhn.12.1.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

Jhn.11.19.bsb: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of their brother.
Jhn.11.19.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

Jhn.16.17.bsb: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
Jhn.16.17.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

Jhn.1.44.bsb: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
Jhn.1.44.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

Jhn.6.65.bsb: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
Jhn.6.65.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

Jhn.4.13.bsb: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
Jhn.4.13.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

Jhn.19.2.bsb: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.
Jhn.19.2.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

Jhn.1.8.bsb: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
Jhn.1.8.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

Jhn.16.20.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
Jhn.16.20.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

Jhn.4.4.bsb: Now He had to pass through Samaria.
Jhn.4.4.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.

Jhn.7.13.bsb: Yet no one would speak publicly about Him for fear of the Jews.
Jhn.7.13.kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

Jhn.20.19.bsb: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.
Jhn.20.19.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

Jhn.7.45.bsb: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring Him in?”
Jhn.7.45.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

Jhn.1.15.bsb: John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, “This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’”
Jhn.1.15.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

Jhn.6.42.bsb: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?”
Jhn.6.42.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

Jhn.5.1.bsb: Some time later there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
Jhn.5.1.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

Jhn.2.12.bsb: After this, He went down to Capernaum with His mother and brothers and His disciples, and they stayed there a few days.
Jhn.2.12.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

Jhn.11.7.bsb: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
Jhn.11.7.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judea again.

Jhn.21.14.bsb: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
Jhn.21.14.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

Jhn.10.18.bsb: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”
Jhn.10.18.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

Jhn.6.9.bsb: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
Jhn.6.9.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

Jhn.20.7.bsb: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
Jhn.20.7.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

Jhn.11.9.bsb: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
Jhn.11.9.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

Jhn.4.31.bsb: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
Jhn.4.31.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

Jhn.21.1.bsb: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:
Jhn.21.1.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

Jhn.12.47.bsb: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
Jhn.12.47.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

Jhn.6.24.bsb: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
Jhn.6.24.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

Jhn.11.13.bsb: They thought that Jesus was talking about actual sleep, but He was speaking about the death of Lazarus.
Jhn.11.13.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

Jhn.11.31.bsb: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
Jhn.11.31.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

Jhn.13.29.bsb: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
Jhn.13.29.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

Jhn.11.56.bsb: They kept looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple courts, “What do you think? Will He come to the feast at all?”
Jhn.11.56.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
